key_insight: VIBES replaces pixel reconstruction with a sufficiency-focused objective that helps reinforcement learning models retain task-relevant information while ignoring distractors.
engineering_relevance: Designed as a drop-in replacement for Dreamer’s model-learning component, VIBES supports visual and high-dimensional vector inputs without image-specific augmentations.
method: Use an adversarial objective to make latent states sufficient for predicting rewards and next latent states.
Apply a fixed-capacity latent bottleneck to encourage removal of irrelevant variation.
Connect global optima to bisimulation on histories when exact sufficiency is attainable.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports state-of-the-art Distracting Control Suite performance, evaluations on Realistic ManiSkill and a 100-link swimmer, and latent-space probes supporting distractor invariance.
watch_item: The bisimulation guarantee assumes exact sufficiency is attainable; practical performance may depend on bottleneck capacity and adversarial optimization.
paper_title: Distractor-Robust Reinforcement Learning via Variational Bisimulation
